billing.title: Billing
billing.scope: Only channels added through this desk are counted
billing.schedule: Aggregation starts at 00:00 and publishes overnight (by 06:00 at the latest)
billing.nonePublished: No bill has been published yet
billing.periodLine: Period {day} · publishes when the pull finishes · by 06:00 at the latest
billing.testLine: From channel tests. Not included in the supplier total

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.scope: Only channels added through this desk
recon.description: After a bill is published we check baselines, logs, and status. Tolerance is {tolerance}%. Test logs are removed from both sides.
recon.nonePublished: No bill has been published yet
recon.adjustHint: A locked month keeps the check as it was. Only adjustment records can be added.
recon.spanNote: A multi-day total is compared as one combined figure, never split.

reasons.reset: Baseline fell. The channel may have been recreated or its quota reset.
reasons.self: Yesterday's baseline plus consumption does not equal today's baseline
reasons.disabled_growth: A disabled channel is still consuming
reasons.zero_streak: An enabled channel has had no consumption for several days
reasons.purged: The gateway has no logs for that day
reasons.missing: Missing on the gateway. The amount comes from snapshots.

defs.match: The bill and the logs agree within tolerance.
defs.anomaly: The difference is outside tolerance, or the baseline or status looks wrong.
defs.pending: The daily check has not reached a result yet. On supplier reconciliation this is awaiting confirmation.
defs.unsynced: The baseline has not been pulled, so it is left out of the total.
defs.missing_logs: That day's logs are missing, so the amount cannot be checked.

recon.rebindReject: The target must exist. If that id is already bound, the request is rejected and names the record and supplier. It is not stolen.
recon.manualHint: Supplier reconciliation is monthly. A gap within ±{tolerance}% can pass automatically. Uploads stay on the same local record.

settings.adminOnly: Only an admin can configure gateways and rate limits.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: A gateway stores the New API site, system access token, and admin user id. Suppliers can only add channels on these gateways.
settings.tokenHint: After save only a mask is shown. The API never returns the token again. Leave it blank to keep the current one.
settings.name: Name
settings.savedGateway: Gateway saved. The access token stays on the server.
settings.limitsHint: Requests over the limit wait in a queue instead of failing. A 429 honors Retry-After; otherwise the wait backs off.
settings.limitsSaved: Limits updated. Queued requests continue under the new limits.
settings.demoReady: The demo gateway is ready on Channels and Billing.
settings.zeroDays: Zero-consumption days before a status flag
settings.reconHint: Reconciliation runs after a bill is published. Manual-entry tolerance is reserved at {manual}% and is not used yet.
settings.supplierHint: You can change your password. The billing schedule is read-only.
settings.scheduleBody: Starts 00:00 · publishes when the pull finishes · latest 06:00 (Asia/Shanghai)

users.adminOnly: Only an admin can manage users.
users.title: Users
users.description: Admins create suppliers, reset passwords, and disable accounts. There is no public registration. Disabled accounts cannot sign in.
users.createHint: This creates a supplier. There is no separate end-user role.
users.created: Supplier created. They can sign in with this username.

system.errorBody: You can retry. Details that might contain a token are not shown.
